Agent Name: Fitness_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent produced an incorrect candidate list of gyms “within 200 meters” of Tompkins Square Park, omitting CrossFit East River and Avea Pilates (which meet the criteria) and listing other venues instead. This misidentification of nearby gyms led all subsequent schedule checks down the wrong path, resulting in the incorrect conclusion that no qualifying classes existed.
